definitions.explanation: Carefully examining or investigating something to determine its quality, authenticity, or suitability.
Selecting items carefully by examining their quality, often used for ingredients or materials.

examples.japanese: {契約|けいやく}{内容|ないよう}を{吟味|ぎんみ}する。
{素材|そざい}を{吟味|ぎんみ}して{選|えら}ぶ。
examples.english: Carefully select and choose the materials.

examples.japanese: {吟味|ぎんみ}された{食材|しょくざい}のみを{使用|しよう}しています。
examples.english: We use only carefully selected ingredients.

notes:
WORD STRUCTURE:
{吟|ぎん} (to recite, examine) + {味|み} (taste, examine)
Originally meant to taste and assess poetry or literature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{吟味|ぎんみ}を{重|かさ}ねる - to examine repeatedly
・{吟味|ぎんみ}に{吟味|ぎんみ}を{重|かさ}ねる - to scrutinize with extreme care
・{厳選|げんせん}{吟味|ぎんみ} - strict selection and examination

USAGE CONTEXTS:
・{食材|しょくざい}の{吟味|ぎんみ} - careful selection of ingredients
・{言葉|ことば}の{吟味|ぎんみ} - careful choice of words
・{証拠|しょうこ}の{吟味|ぎんみ} - examination of evidence

FORMALITY:
Slightly formal. Often used in business, legal, and culinary contexts. {吟味|ぎんみ}された implies high quality and careful selection.
